messages:
incident-bot: Paging: SLO breach detected on /v1/stream (p95=420ms, p99=1.9s) since ~10:02 UTC. Impacting streaming clients. auto-escalate: oncall@sara_oncall.

sara_oncall: saw the alert, joining. any obvious rollout?

mike_infra: rolling config pushed at 09:58 that updated quant profile for redwood-6b to int8-agg-calib-v3. telemetry shows tail latency jump right after.

priya_runtime: yep correlates. calibration step changed out KV cache alignment and introduced extra dequant on long sequences -> stalls for streams >1024 tokens.

jon_sre: p95 ramped from 120ms -> 420ms, p99 spikes to 1.9s, streaming stall count up 8x. scope: region-us-west, model variant redwood-6b-int8-calib-v3.

amanda_support: Customer-reported: AcornPayments says several in-progress payments timed out (~40 sessions affected). They're escalating.

sara_oncall: mobilizing bridge. priority: mitigate customer impact first. options: rollback quant profile, route live traffic to fp16 variant, or enable fallback routing to dedicated capacity. Thoughts? :warning:

mike_infra: fastest is routing streaming requests to redwood-6b-fp16-stable (same model but fp16). can flip routing policy for streaming endpoints to prefer fp16 for 1h.

priya_runtime: rolling rollback of calib-v3 takes longer because of new kernels. fallback route switch is immediate and safe. also we can disable prefix-KV reuse that seems to hit the dequant hotpath (cheap change).

jon_sre: propose two-step: 1) immediate traffic reroute to fp16-stable for streaming; 2) disable KV-reuse on int8 variant; 3) follow up with rollback of calib-v3 after verification.

sara_oncall: agree. mike, apply routing change and post status. priya, toggle KV-reuse flag. I'll notify support and execs.

mike_infra: changing routing policy now. command: ```
# switch streaming routing to prefer fp16-stable
redwood routing update --route /v1/stream --prefer-model redwood-6b-fp16-stable --duration 3600
```

mike_infra: routing change pushed. starting handshake with load balancer. watching metrics.

priya_runtime: disabling KV reuse on calib-v3 instances: ```
# flip kv_cache_reuse=false on nodes tagged calib-v3
redwood runtime update --tag calib-v3 --set kv_cache_reuse=false
```

priya_runtime: flag toggled on 45 nodes. rolling restart of background daemons initiated (non-disruptive).

jon_sre: metrics update: p95 dropped to 150ms within 90s of routing change, p99 trending down to 420ms. streaming stall rate down 70%.

amanda_support: pinged AcornPayments: they confirm sessions are recovering, fewer timeouts. they're asking for postmortem and ETA for permanent fix.

sara_oncall: good. immediate mitigation success. Next steps: schedule rollback of calib-v3 tomorrow 03:00 UTC (low traffic) OR iterate on calibration fix. Priya, can you reproduce locally and confirm root cause by EOD?

priya_runtime: reproducing in staging with long-context generator. hypothesis: new quant kernel combined with cache reuse causes a lockstep dequant on streaming hot keys -> serialization under high concurrency. I can validate a patch (fix kernel ordering + safety-check) in a few hours.

jon_sre: capture forensic telemetry for the playbook: a) exact build+config id of calib-v3 b) node list impacted c) sample traces for streaming stalls. I'll dump and attach to ticket.

amanda_support: I'll draft customer note: short summary, mitigation done, ETA for permanent fix. share for review.

sara_oncall: assign followups: PRIYA -> fix & test calibration patch; MIKE -> confirm routing rollback window and prepare runbook to flip back; JON -> collect traces/postmortem sections; AMANDA -> customer comms. I'll hand off to triage in morning.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated; severity=high -> transition to followup. incident_id=INC-2026-872.

priya_runtime: quick note: we should add a gating check for calibration changes that simulates streaming long-context workloads to catch this in CI. filing a GH issue now.

mike_infra: prepared rollback script and canaries for tomorrow. will coordinate with oncall rotation.

jon_sre: saved relevant traces here: https://internal.redwood/trace/INC-2026-872 (private).

amanda_support: customer note ready, sending now. will attach timeline and mitigation steps.

sara_oncall: wrapping: incident resolved for now, all hands runbook in the incident ticket. thanks all. :heart:
